newsitem.title: USA: Barney's in pact with Dickson Concepts.
newsitem.headline: Barney's in pact with Dickson Concepts.

text.p: Barney's Inc said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement with Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd under which Dickson will submit, upon completion of due diligence, a definitive proposal to participate in a recapitalization of Barneys.
The agreement also provides for the reimbursement by Barney's of up to $1.0 million to complete Dickson's remaining due diligence.
Barney's said that the agreement, which is subject to U.S. Bankruptcy Court approval, has the support of the Official Committee of Unsecured Creditors.
The due diligence is expected to be completed within six weeks after court approval, the company said.
Dickson Concepts is an international retailing and wholesaling company, which owns retailer Harvey Nichols in London, and S.T. Dupont SA, a French manufacturer of luxury items.
Barney's Inc, a New York-based retailer, filed a voluntary petition of reorganization under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code in January.
